summary: Address Greptile security and correctness findings on the Cookidoo package.
reason: Review identified unsafe MCP executable selection, unparsed HTML recipe output, data-source provenance mismatches, concurrent profile write races, and compacted ingredient amounts.
validated_outcome: Regression tests cover blocked MCP executable selection, JSON-LD extraction in the recipes_get handler, live-only source validation, compact ingredient quantity and unit retention, and concurrent profile updates. The complete test and race suites, vet, and build pass with Go 1.26.9 and a temporary replacement to the MCP-Go version already cached on this host; the PR CI will verify the package's pinned MCP-Go dependency.
